pages.title: Both Ways
pages.text: Two polarities let you control magnetic movement direction.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Azure repels and Scarlet attracts. Matching ingots increase range; opposing ingots reduce it. Leave movement clearance.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Metal gear responds to crystal fields; nonmagnetic gear avoids forces and metal boots walk Scarlet surfaces. Packed Galena yields iron; Teletors provide renewable Telecores for the workshop.
